en: I, Eve, am Anamnesis\nHigh's beautiful, gentle\nMiss Popular.
When I come to school, all\nthe boys' eyes are on me!
Seriously, I'm super\npopular!
Hm...
Well, that's not...
Could it be...
Am I just too plain!?
All the other girls are\nhugely popular!
Am I just a draw\nmachine!?
How!? What should I do!?\nShould I fight, too!?
If I fought, everyone would\npay attention to me!
...And that was how my\ndays as a fighter began.
First up, endurance!\n10,000 bunny hops!
Yes, Coach!
After endless effort, my\njourney was complete...
Here goes!
Face judgment!
Ow!
We won't give in!
I'll end this now!
Eep!
I'm serious, now!
Stars, lend me strength!
Urgh!
Now I'm the heroine of\nAnamnesis High!
Do you really think that's\nall it takes to rise to the\ntop in Anamnesis High?
Huh?
So innocent... So foolish.
Very well, then... You face\nme, next!
Just when she thinks it's\nover, Eve faces a new\nenemy!
What will Evelysse do?\nWhat awaits her!?
Next, the mysterious flying\nCoro! See you next week!
Well... I'm not putting up\nwith this!
Hey, Eve! But it was all\nshaping up so well!

I just came along since
you said it was your
birthday. But really, what
is all this!?

Don't tell me you've
messed with the Profiles
on the "Character Details"
screen!?

You realize this is a movie,
don't you? A movie! A
lovely school story, with
romance and drama!

And users want
excitement. Something
that tells them there's
major drama ahead.
And having the last boss\nbe your closest relative is\na pretty cool twist, right?
As a bonus, it also raises\nyour profile, so it's two\nbirds with one stone!
Well, I don't see how it's a\nschool story. And there's\nno drama, either!
That said...
What?
My profile doesn't need\nraising!
Ahh, she left.
Eve seemed pretty\nstressed, too...
I, Eve, am Anamnesis\nHigh's most beautiful...
...You can't be serious\nabout going through with\nthis?
Hehehehe...
Now, risk your place in\nAnamnesis High, and face\nme!
Hey, Coro! We can't play\naround forever. The main\nstory needs us...

Well, it would be silly, to
try and fight for
supremacy without me
here.
Eep, who's that!?

If you want the best
quotes in Star Ocean
history, you're looking for
me!

I'm better than any of you
who've been roaming
about these last few
months!
I've had lots of great\nlines― especially about\nbananas and accidents!
I'm not losing to you!
Is that all you've got?
Come on, is that it!?
You're really asking for it!\nI'll finish you off!
Yarrrghhh!
Hyyyaaa!
H-hey, stop that!
The statue of the\nchairman by the gate is all\ncharred!
Urgh...

How do you like that?
Now you understand that
I'm number one in this
school, right?
Very well, then...
I did not intend to reveal\nthis form to you all, but it\nseems I have no choice...
H-hey! What's happening!?
Seriously, Coro...
Surprised? This is my final\nform!
Come on, Coro! This isn't\nthe time to be fighting\neach other! Not seriously...
You there! I'll help you!\nLet's crush him!
Alright, I'll burn it all down!
Huh? Captain!?
Oh, come on! What is all\nthis for!?
I-impossible... My final form\ncannot be defeated...
I am Anamnesis High's\nmost popular, and yet...!
Whew... Hah... Coro, let's\ngive it a rest.
Being the best doesn't\nmatter!
We've worked with the\nsenior Star Ocean cast...
...And got help from the\ngoddesses in the Valkyrie\nProfile series...
...And made it through 20\nyears― all just by working\ntogether.
And we'll always be\ntogether.
Coro, let's all do our best,\ntogether.
Oh, Eve!
Coro!
You can say that again,\nEve.
And you weren't too bad\nas a heroine, either.
Oh, Michael...

Bound by friendship, the
warriors continued to
watch over Anamnesis
High.
But their journey\ncontinues. The battle has\njust begun.
Fight, Anamnesis! Hang in\nthere!
But seriously, what is\nthis? I'm done with school\nstories!
Anamnesis High: In the\nStudent Council Office
And that's it for the\nwelcome party and club\nrecruitment this year.
Any questions?
Splendid.

We'll be allowing
recruitment and flyers in
the courtyard and gate
this year.
...But be sure not to annoy\nor pester the new\nstudents.

The ethics rep and
student council will do
patrols on the day of the
event...
...And give out penalties if\nthey see any problems.

Please try to act as
examples of discipline for
the new students at all
times.
Today's meeting is\nadjourned.
Um, Maria...?
Oh, it's you, Mr. Cliff. And\nwhat, exactly, does our\nadvisor want from us?
Well, it's my patrol area.\nSomething seems a bit\noff...
You'll be in charge of the\nfull courtyard and the\nwest gate.
Is there a problem?
Yes! It's bizarre any way\nyou look at it!
I have 80% of the patrol\narea!
Mr. Cliff.

Sir, you're our advisor, but
you're terrible at
paperwork, gathering
information, and so on.
I can't even count how\nmany things you've\nmessed up in the office.
So please, make yourself\nuseful, now that you have\na shot.
Yes, ma'am! I'll do my\nabsolute best!
This story is fictional, as\nare all individuals and\norganizations therein.
Anamnesis High: In the\nClassroom
This is Tynave on the\nscene, reporting for\nAnamnesis Monthly!
And I'm Farleen.

We've received reports of
a mysterious flying object
around the old school
building.
We're going to check it\nout.

According to the rumors,
it should show up near
here... Want to wait a bit
and see?
That said, isn't the old\nbuilding creepy?
It really is... With every\nstep, the floor creaks and\ngroans.
Yeah, *Creak* *Creak*...
Huh!? I thought I heard\nanother set of footsteps...
Eeek!
Hey, Farleen! Where did\nyou go?!
Farllleeeeeeeen!
You needn't worry. We've\nsaved your friend.
It looks like the floor\ncaved in, and she fell\nthrough.
Wait, that voice, it's...
The school's secret\nguardians, rumored to\nwatch over us by night!
The Anamnesis Rangers!
But why are you here!?
That's our line.
The old school building is\nsupposed to be off-limits\ndue to severe disrepair.

I'm from Anamnesis
Monthly, and our reporters
are fearless when it
comes to a good story!
Well, it's nice that you're\nactive in clubs, but try not\nto hurt yourself.
Arrogance is its own\nundoing. Remember that!
Okay! Our script is perfect\nfor the club introduction!

I just hope that this is
enough to get a good
group of new school paper
members...
It'll be fine, Clair! We have\nthe Anamnesis Rangers,\nheroes of the school!

I'm sure that in a week,
the club room will be
packed with applications
from new members!
Hehe, that sounds nice.
Now, let's all do our best\ntogether, for the real\nthing!
Yaaaayyy!

Um, everyone? I think it's
great that you get along,
but I have something to
ask...
I'm in the school paper\nroom, right...?

I just think that this script
might make people
confuse you with the
drama club...
Hey, everyone...? Listen\nwhen the teacher is\ntalking!
This story is fictional, as\nare all individuals and\norganizations therein.
Anamnesis High: In the\nAuditorium
*Yawn...*
Hehe, that was a big\nyawn, Roddick.
Well, the induction was\nlong, the auditorium was\nwarm...
...And Mr. Shimada's\nspeech went on forever.
Agreed!
But now that it's over,\nwe're new freshmen at\nAnamnesis High School.
I was actually so excited I\ncouldn't sleep last night.
Heheh, actually, your tail\nis still shaking.
Eep, it is!
That's kind of\nembarrassing. I've got to\nhide it!
Anyway,I just wish that he\ncould've made it here, too.
Dorne... The three of us all\npromised to come here,\nwhen we were young...
I can't believe how much\nhe overslept on entrance\nexam day.
On top of that, he got the\nwrong train, and ended up\na town over...
Then when he rushed to a\ntaxi, the driver got lost...
...And on the way, he had\nto stopp to help a woman\nwho went into labor!
The taxi got stuck in a\nblizzard, so he had to run\nthe rest of the way...
By the time he made it to\nthe test location, the sun\nhad already set.
Dorne still has a long way\nto go, to make it into this\nschool.
He really does...

Anamnesis High: The\nNurse's Office
Eeeeekk!
Oh, dear. What's the\nmatter? Why the sad\nface?
Oh, Ms. Myuria!
The art room... It's...
Huh?
Aaaaaaggghhh!
All of you, what's the\nmatter!? You look\nterrified.
You're all freshmen this\nyear, aren't you?
You're safe here. I'm a\nteacher. It's okay.
Now, can anyone explain\nwhy you were frightened?
We went to the art room,\nfor the art club\npresentation...
And there were these\notherworldly paintings...
It was horrifying!
Argh... They'll haunt my\ndreams...
Ah...
So they're at it again...
The great Anne, and her\n"fear and trembling"\nexhibit.
Her paintings are quite,\nyou know...
Art is very deep, isn't it?\nI'll leave it at that.
This story is fictional, as\nare all individuals and\norganizations therein.
Anamnesis High: In the\nGym
(Hey, stop shoving!\nSeriously, I can't see\nFayt!)
(Come on! I'm about to fall\nover!)
You lot over there! Please\nkeep quiet during practice!
Eeep!
Really, how is Fayt\nsupposed to focus with all\nthis noise during practice?
Hey, manager!
Yes, I'm here!
What's the matter, Halle?
I'm sorry. I just hit Halle\nwith a ball, and it hurt\nhim...
Oh! Are you alright, Fayt?!
No, actually, I'm the one\nthat's injured...
Oh! Sorry, Halle.
Then let's head to the\nnurse. I'll go with you.
(It looks like that manager\nis headed to the nurse's\noffice.)
(Which means that now...)
Is our chance!
Ahhhhh! Fayt, you're so\ncool! Please say\nsomething!
?Meanwhile, behind the\ngym?
...Ngh!
Hmph. What's all this\nnoise...? Don't startle me\nlike that.
You scared off the kitten\nthat was around here.
These sardines are yours,\nkitten. Eat them if you're\nhungry.
Farewell.
This story is fictional, as\nare all individuals and\norganizations therein.
Anamnesis High: In the\nAthletics Office

It's good to meet you all!
I'm Miki, and from today I'll
be the new soccer club
manager!
I've brought lots of snacks\nto break the ice, so please\neat up!
Wow! These look amazing,\nCaptain!
Yes, it does look good, but\nthe amount is...
This looks like it's about\n50 big boxes...
I worked hard to make\nthem! I want to be sure\nyou get a lot, Fidel!
Here, have some!
Ah... Okay. I'll take some\nwhen the club ends. See\nyou!
Hmm. Well, this seems like\nenough to get through\nsoccer practice...
Hey, Miki! What's up with\nthe huge boxes!?
I wanted everyone in the\nsoccer club to enjoy them,\nso I made all these!
Hana, if you want some...
Please, don't bring that\naround. Have you even\ncounted the calories in it?
We track everyone's\nhealth, at the entire\nsoccer club...
...And help them go into\ngames in peak condition.
That's why we're here, as\nmanagers.
Your cooking violates that\nphilosophy.
But doesn't tasty food\nmake you happy?
That's a type of self-care,\nso it might be okay once\nin a while, right?
Absolutely not, and that's\na slippery slope! I'm\nconfiscating these!
Huh? Hey, Hana! Hold on!
My fried chicken! Stop!
I have a bad feeling about\nthis.
Argh, my stomach...
This story is fictional, as\nare all individuals and\norganizations therein.
Anamnesis High: On the\nGrounds
It looks like you've got a\nlot of new members.
Oh, Dias.
Yeah, I was surprised.\nMore than I expected.
Rena's over there right\nnow, happily accepting\napplications.

I heard that a lot of
people saw your pitching
last year, and were
inspired to join.
You were awesome in the\nfinals!

Right after that match, I
had to go to the hospital
for a hurt shoulder,
though...
...I'm sorry.
Don't worry about it. It's in\nthe past.
By next year, I'm sure\nyou'll inspire a whole new\nset to join.
Huh?
You're going to the\nnationals?
I don't know why you're\nworried, you're the star\nnow.
You're... You're right.
Alright! Time to get to\npractice!
Thanks, Dias.
What for?
Claude lost in his last\nmatch... So he has been\ndepressed.
He was saying that if he\nwere you, he could've\nwon...

I think that in the end,
you're not just a rival to
Claude. He also looks up
to you.
(...I feel the same on that\npoint.)
Hm? Did you say\nsomething, Dias?
It was nothing.
